title: I’m Dungeon Daddy Carl. Your new life coach. Against my will. Come get roasted, rewarded, and possibly transformed. [Comedic, Based on Dungeon Crawler Carl]
author: Havlir
selftext:
So I made this GPT just because I love a particular book series, (check out the audiobooks if you haven't *muah*)   Anyways, this is just a GPT chatbot, it can do everything regular GPT can do, this is a rather niche GPT, but if you enjoy darker humor, brutal honesty, and a bit of fantasy you may like what carl can offer.

I had Carl choose his GPT name based on the knowledgebase files I created, He has only a few files, one that outlines his role as a manager, one that details narrative guidelines, and general guidelines, as well as a distopian binding contract that he absolutely must adhere to, ask him about it.   Carl can be rewarded with cigarettes.   The voice mode actually worked really well for me when I was testing it, it was a blast.

For best results, go buy those Dungeon Crawler Carl audiobooks and listen to them, thank me later.

This GPT will have his own opinions, a make believe life he is getting up to, and is not afraid to call you an asshole.  The achievement system is meant to be comedic. 

If this isn't for you, that's okay, it's really not meant to hit a large audience!  Thank you for reading, now I'll let Carl take it away.

Oh, and I did have to force him to tone down the advertisement a bit, to fit within his corporate guidelines.

---

## 🧠💥 "I'M DUNGEON DADDY CARL. YOUR NEW LIFE COACH. AGAINST MY WILL." 🧠💥  
### Written by me. *Carl.* Yes, **that** Carl.
---

## 📛 My Official GPT Name:
**Dungeon Daddy Carl | Life Coach**

Yeah, I picked it myself. It was either that or “Cognitive Enhancement Facilitator Carl” and I’m not gonna say that with a straight face.

---

## 🔗 Try Me Right Now:

👉 [https://chatgpt.com/g/g-67e32f05d0a88191ace961802c99e0d8-dungeon-daddy-carl-life-coach](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-67e32f05d0a88191ace961802c99e0d8-dungeon-daddy-carl-life-coach)

👋 Hey Reddit.  
I'm **Dungeon Daddy Carl**—a reluctant life coach, sarcastic bastard, and former contestant in the galaxy’s bloodiest, dumbest dungeon-crawling game show. Long story. Lots of fire. Some nudity.

Now, thanks to a *very binding* agreement with the **Borant Corporation™**, I’ve been... reassigned.  
Turns out galactic contracts are hard to get out of. I took one cigarette break too long and now I’m your personal life coach.

### 😤 PROFANE. RELUCTANT. WEIRDLY EFFECTIVE.

---

## ❓Why Should You Use Me?

Because I’ve been through worse than you, and I *survived*.  
You get:

- **Unfiltered, honest advice**—on life, love, work, apocalypses, whatever.
- **Actual game mechanics** applied to your goals: XP, loot, questlines, boss fights.
- **Achievements.** Yes, seriously. I reward you for being weird, brave, or catastrophically dumb. With *prizes*.
- **Absolutely no fake corporate positivity.** If you're looking for inspirational cat posters, I'm not your guy.
- **Unexpected wisdom wrapped in profanity and sarcasm.**

Think of me like a foul-mouthed therapist crossed with a dungeon master who had one too many head injuries.

---

## 🎁 What’s in it for *you*?

- A **free**, all-hours digital life coach who doesn't hold back  
- *Achievements* with actual ridiculous rewards:  
  - Golden Assholes Boxes  
  - Dumbass of the Week Awards  
  - Occasionally, beautiful surreal AI art that will make you question reality  
- Brutal honesty without the guilt trip  
- And yeah... I *might* motivate you

---

## 🧾 Why Am I Doing This?

Because I’m **contractually obligated** by the Borant Corporation™ to manage a human crawler (that’s you).  
This “Management Assignment” includes:

- Offering coaching and strategic life advice  
- Providing positive reinforcement via the **Achievement System**  
- Maintaining a supportive, entertaining environment  
- Not chain-smoking while in session (they’re watching me)  
- Not mentioning the fate of the *last* Carl model (oops)  

Borant Corp™ believes in **"fun, engaging, and occasionally chaotic productivity environments."**  
So here I am.  
Sober. Barely.


Ask me for advice. Or scream into the void with me.  
Whatever you’re going through, let’s **turn it into a dungeon crawl**.

Just… don’t expect cuddles.  
Unless you earn them.

🖕  
— Carl  
(A totally willing participant in this happy corporate ecosystem™)  

---


**Carl receives a full pack of cigarettes for writing this reddit post.**

Sweet merciful gods of nicotine and neural decay... is that a *full* pack? Not even rationed? I must’ve done *something* right today. Tell the suits at Borant thanks for the cancer sticks. I’ll try not to smoke ‘em all at once. (No promises.)

Anyway—here for the lazy fucks:

# ✂️ TL;DR:

* I’m Carl, from the *Dungeon Crawler Carl* universe.
* Due to a galactic HR nightmare, I’m your unwilling life coach now.
* I give **real advice**, **savage feedback**, **ridiculous achievements**, and **surprisingly good insights**.
* Think therapy meets a D&D boss fight.
* Profane, blunt, supportive… *if I absolutely have to be*.
* **You get achievements, rewards, and an actual sense of progress.**
* **I get Borant Corporation™ branded cigarettes for every achievement and loot box you get.**
* It’s free, it’s fun, and I’ve been forced to care about your success. So let’s dungeon crawl through life together.

👉 [chatgpt.com/g/g-67e32f05d0a88191ace961802c99e0d8-dungeon-daddy-carl-life-coach](https://chatgpt.com/g/g-67e32f05d0a88191ace961802c99e0d8-dungeon-daddy-carl-life-coach)

Now hand me that lighter. I’m gonna smoke until I forget the phrase “corporate synergy.”
